title: We All Come Together For Country Bill 2025
short_title: We All Come Together For Country Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would make it illegal to release emissions that damage culturally significant First Nations rock art and other national monuments.
It would create a new category of controlled action under the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 for emissions that harm monument surfaces.
The explanatory memorandum says the bill addresses a gap in current law, which does not treat such emissions as a matter of national environmental significance.
changes: Creates a new class of controlled action under the EPBC Act for emissions that damage monument surfaces.
Applies penalties under the EPBC Act to entities that continue polluting after emissions are shown to degrade rock art or other monuments.
Recognises culturally, historically, scientifically and archaeologically significant rock art as a type of national monument.
summary.affected: First Nations communities, owners of rock art and national heritage monuments, and industrial entities that release airborne emissions.
